description: A key whose every union constituent is a string literal narrows to exactly those members: `box[safeKey]` touches a data property and a clean getter and passes, while `box[riskyKey]` touches the throwing one and is reported.

diagnostics.message: Reading `box[riskyKey]` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `risky`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `risky` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
